messages:
anya: Heads-up — saw a pattern in eu-prod: ~0.3% of WS connections hang during subprotocol negotiation. Clients keep retrying the `INIT` frame and we end up with multiple partial sessions. Console shows duplicated token counts for affected routes. Anyone seen this?
kevin: saw noise like this yesterday in us-west. logs had lots of repeated `ws_upgrade` attempts then `half-handshake` entries. grabbing a snippet now.
kevin: ```
[2025-11-03T11:04:12.312Z] edge-proxy: conn=abcd123 upgrade=start subproto=redwood.v1
[2025-11-03T11:04:12.427Z] edge-sidecar: conn=abcd123 recv=INIT id=xyz
[2025-11-03T11:04:12.428Z] lb: conn=abcd123 retrying pre-upgrade (timeout)
[2025-11-03T11:04:12.429Z] edge-sidecar: conn=abcd123 half-handshake (no-session-id)
[2025-11-03T11:04:12.430Z] orchestration: created partial-session pid=ps-789
```
ram: interesting — it smells like LB/proxy retrying the TCP->WS upgrade before the backend finished the subprotocol handshake, leaving the backend to create a partial session object. If client retries, we create another partial session and token accounting hits twice.
sylvie: dashboard callout: /v1/stream (eu) shows 4x delta in tokens-per-conn for the spike window (11:04–11:07). console metric `route.token_usage_dup_rate` jumped to 0.27. I've pinned the alert.
anya: quick mitigation idea: enforce server-side handshake timeout so partial sessions are garbage-collected faster and reject upgrades without a `x-session-handshake-id` header. Can we add a short lived handshake TTL at the edge (15s) and a semantic header to de-dupe at the accounting layer?
ram: "+1" on the header. Plan: (1) require `x-rw-ws-handshake-id` at upgrade; (2) at create-session path check idempotency (if seen recently, extend session rather than creating new); (3) short GC for orphaned partial sessions. We can patch the accounting pipeline to tag tokens with handshake-id and dedupe when reporting to console.
sylvie: for the console side we need a migration plan — existing dashboards expect conn-id only. Add fallback label `handshake_id || conn_id` and keep both for 7 days. That should avoid missing historical queries.
kevin: is this risky for rollout? edge change + sidecar + accounting tweak + console tag migration. I'd prefer a staged rollout: edge config + flag in sidecar (canary 5%) -> accounting dedupe behind a feature flag -> console label migration opt-in -> wider rollout.
anya: agree. also need a short-term stopgap: set `edge.ws_upgrade_timeout=10s` and `proxy.retry_on_upgrade=0` in eu for 1 hour to stop the double-creates while we validate the patch.
sylvie: pushed an alert note and pinned the 5m graph to the runbook. @deploy-bot can we get a quick revertable config push to eu edge?
deploy-bot: deploy started: config/edge/eu -> set ws_upgrade_timeout=10s, proxy_retry_on_upgrade=false (can rollback in 5m). CI checks passed.
ram: I'll start the handshake-id patch PR. adding test for repeated INIT frames and ensuring accounting dedupe works when handshake-id matches.
kevin: small nit — if we add handshake-id, make sure SDKs (websocket client) don't need changes: we can have the edge synthesize handshake-id from the first INIT if client doesn't send it, but only when we can guarantee idempotency. Prefer clients to send it but not required at first.
anya: good call. make edge synthesize but mark synthesized vs client-provided in tag so we can iterate.
sylvie: monitoring plan: watch `console.route.token_usage_dup_rate`, `edge.partial_sessions_gc_rate`, `accounting.dedupe_hit_rate` and standard error/latency. Canary window 30m then 5% -> 25% -> 100%.
kevin: update docs for runbook notes (how to interpret dedupe metrics) and add rollback playbook.
anya: timeline: ram will open PR now, aim for small canary in eu by EOD. deploy-bot, leave the config rollback open.
ram: PR opened: https://git.internal/r/patches/1245 — tests included. tagging @kevin @sylvie.
sylvie: :thumbsup: thanks. I'll keep the console alert muted during the canary and surface synthetic metric `handshake_id_synthesized_pct`.
anya: closing the loop: if canary healthy at +1h, proceed with accounting dedupe flag for 25% and console label migration.
kevin: thanks all — great cross-team ops.
console: Note: dashboard annotation added for 2025-11-03 11:04 EU spike."
